summary: Happy City Holdings Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) with YA II PN, Ltd. Under the SEPA, the company has the right, but not obligation, to issue up to $20 million of Class A ordinary shares over 36 months, with the purchase price at the lowest three-day VWAP. No mandatory drawdowns exist. The company paid a $25,000 structuring fee and issued 72,401 shares as part of a commitment fee. This facility provides flexible capital returns to support liquidity or strategic initiatives. Proceeds use will be detailed later. Watch for drawdowns and registration statement effectiveness.
